mod.securities_registry.subtitle: Capitalization table management, share allocation, certificate generation, and general meetings.
uf005.title: Share Class Creation
uf005.description: This workflow allows configuring the different security classes associated with an issuer. Each share class has its own attributes: voting rights, economic rights (dividends, liquidation preference), transfer restrictions, and other capital structure specificities.
uf005.step1_desc: Navigate to the relevant issuer profile within the Securities Registry.
uf005.step2_desc: Access the list of existing share classes for this issuer.
uf005.step3_desc: Initialize a new share class by entering its name and category (common, preferred, etc.).
uf005.step4_desc: Define all associated rights and attributes: voting weight, dividend rights, transfer restrictions, liquidation preference.
uf005.step5_desc: Save and immediately make available for security allocation to investors.
uf006.title: Share Allocation
uf006.description: This workflow covers the assignment of securities to an identified investor in the registry. Security allocation updates the share register and automatically triggers an update to the issuer's Cap Table.
uf006.step1_desc: The operator selects the target investor from the KYC-cleared registry.
uf006.step2_desc: Specify share class, quantity, issuance price, and effective date of the operation.
uf006.step3_desc: The system validates data integrity, available authorized capital, and KYC compliance status before proceeding.
uf006.step4_desc: The registry and Cap Table are updated in real time; an audit entry is generated with full transaction details.
uf007.title: Certificate Generation
uf007.description: This workflow enables generating an official shareholding certificate for an investor. The certificate acts as legal proof of ownership at a given date, generated as a PDF.
uf007.step1_desc: Access the issuer's share register containing all holding records.
uf007.step2_desc: Select the specific investor holding record for which the certificate should be generated.
uf007.step3_desc: Trigger PDF generation; the system compiles registry data and applies the official certificate template.
uf007.step4_desc: Download the generated PDF certificate, ready for issuance or archiving.
uf008.title: General Meeting Creation
uf008.description: This workflow allows an operator to create and configure a General Meeting (GM) on behalf of an issuer, defining agenda, date, and notice of meeting.
uf008.step1_desc: Navigate to the issuer file inside the Securities Registry.
uf008.step2_desc: Access the dedicated GM management section for the issuer.
uf008.step3_desc: Initialize a new general meeting (Annual, Extraordinary, or Special).
uf008.step4_desc: Draft the full agenda with numbered resolutions, reports, and attached documents.
uf008.step5_desc: Define date, time, physical location, or virtual meeting link.
uf008.step6_desc: Save the meeting and automatically dispatch notices to all registered shareholders.
uf009.title: Online Voting
uf009.description: Investor workflow to view agenda, review documents, cast secure votes, and receive a timestamped receipt.
uf009.step1_desc: The investor logs in and accesses the authenticated portal.
uf009.step2_desc: View the list of available and upcoming general meetings.
uf009.step3_desc: Access the active meeting agenda, documents, and voting interface.
uf009.step4_desc: Submit a vote (For / Against / Abstain) for each resolution on the agenda.
uf009.step5_desc: The investor reviews and explicitly confirms all submitted votes.
uf009.step6_desc: The vote is stored securely and immutably with cryptographic timestamping.
uf009.step7_desc: A voting receipt is issued and made available in the investor's portal.
uf010.title: Minutes Generation
uf010.description: This workflow triggers automatically upon closing a general meeting to consolidate voting results, generate official minutes, and notify shareholders.
uf010.step1_desc: Official closure of the general meeting — voting is locked and no further votes are accepted.
uf010.step2_desc: The system consolidates all votes per resolution, applies share class voting weights, and checks quorum requirements.
uf010.step3_desc: Automatic generation of the official meeting minutes PDF using the standardized legal template.
uf010.step4_desc: Secure archiving of signed minutes in the issuer's permanent document repository.
uf010.step5_desc: The minutes are distributed to all registered shareholders via notification and portal availability.

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.s1.p: MK Capital Markets Technologies Ltd, registered in DIFC, Dubai, is the data controller for personal data collected through this website and our platforms.
legal.privacy.s2.p: Contact form data (name, work email, organization), platform usage logs, cookies (see Cookie Policy), and, for the Investor Data Room, identity verification data required for AML/KYC compliance.
legal.privacy.s3.p: We rely on legitimate interest for business development outreach, consent for analytics/marketing cookies and newsletters, contractual necessity for client services, and legal obligation for AML/KYC and record-keeping mandates.
legal.privacy.s4.p: Outreach data is retained for up to 24 months from last interaction. Client data adheres to Master Services Agreement (MSA) terms. Regulatory audit logs are kept for 7 years.
legal.privacy.s5.p: Data is hosted in Azure UAE and EU regions. Cross-border transfers rely on Standard Contractual Clauses aligned with GDPR and DIFC DP Law standards.
legal.privacy.s6.p: Access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction, and objection. Contact privacy@mkcmt.io. You may also lodge a complaint with the DIFC Commissioner of Data Protection.
legal.terms.title: Terms of Service

legal.terms.s3.p: All content, registered trademarks, and CCMI product designs are the property of MK Capital Markets Technologies Ltd. Citation for informational purposes is allowed with attribution.

legal.terms.s5.p: These terms are governed by the laws of the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). Disputes fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of DIFC Courts.
legal.cookies.title: Cookie Policy
legal.cookies.s1.p: Cookies are small text files saved on your device to remember preferences and optimize user experience.
legal.cookies.s2.p: Essential (session, security, load balancing) — always enabled. Analytics (Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity) — subject to consent. Marketing (LinkedIn Insight, Meta Pixel) — subject to consent.
legal.cookies.s3.p: Use the cookie banner on your first visit or the preferences link in the footer to modify choices anytime. Rejecting optional cookies does not restrict access to public content.
legal.cookies.s4.p: Certain third parties (Google, Microsoft, LinkedIn, Meta) place cookies governed by their respective privacy policies. Please refer to their privacy notices for details.
legal.cookies.s5.p: Our cookie management aligns with IAB TCF 2.2 framework and DIFC DP Law 2020.
